body:

## Measured (at filing, `objectstack-ai/objectstack`)

- `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/labels/pinned` → **404**; `…/labels/work-in-progress` → **404**; `…/labels/security` → 200; `…/labels/pm:mailbox` → 200.
- `.github/workflows/stale.yml` L53–54 on `origin/main`: `exempt-issue-labels: 'pinned,security,roadmap,tracking'`, `exempt-pr-labels: 'pinned,security,work-in-progress'` — the exemption names two labels that do not exist, so it is dead for them.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` (the fleet's idempotent label creator; its header says a label the fleet relies on is created here) creates `pm:mailbox` at L311 and does not name `pinned`.
- PR #27143 (#27077, the per-seat mailbox) makes `pinned` mandatory on every mailbox PR: `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` sends `PR_LABELS = ['pm:mailbox', 'pinned', 'skip-changeset']` on the relay `pr_create`, and `references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 says `pm:mailbox`+`pinned`. Whether the relay's labels leg creates a missing label on a `pr_create` is a platform reading nobody has taken (0 `pm:mailbox` PRs open at filing; the first open after #27143 lands is the first measurement).

## Wanted

One line in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`: create `pinned` if missing (colour and description in the file's own convention; the description names its two readers: `stale.yml`'s exemption and the mailbox tool). ⛔ Do not add `work-in-progress` unless a reader is named (SKILL.md: a label exists iff it has a named reader; the only reader found is the same `stale.yml` list, with no tool applying it — triage decides). ⛔ No workflow edit; `stale.yml` is Tier H and already names the label.

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈状态模型〉: 「一个标签存在当且仅当有具名读者」 — `pinned` has two readers (the stale sweep's exemption; `mailbox-open.mjs`'s `PR_LABELS`).
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` header: the designed place for a label the fleet relies on.

- P2 `stale.yml` still exempts it: `git grep -n "exempt-pr-labels" origin/main -- .github/workflows/stale.yml` → expect the line naming `pinned`.
- P3 `ensure-pm-labels.sh` still lacks it: `git grep -n "pinned" origin/main -- scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` → expect 0 hits (radius: the file's text; a hit means already fixed).
